title: Sources Sought - Lodging Window Cleaning
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR MOBILITY COMMAND.FA4407  375 CONS LGC
detail_text: The 375 CONS is seeking information for potential sources for exterior window cleaning services for a building located Scott AFB, IL. Please review the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS) for more details. Vendors who wish to respond to this should send responses via email NLT 4:00 PM Central Standard Time (CST) on 09 March 2026 to the following: SSgt Kevin Landa - kevin.landa@us.af.mil Responses should include: 1) Business name and address; 2) Name of company representative, business title and email; 3) Cage Code; 4) DUNS Number; 5) Interested businesses should submit a brief statement demonstrating ability to perform for this requirement, as described above and in the attached PWS. DISCLAIMER: THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY.
